items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I heard the name but I never met him.

ctx.x: Willy Anderson was probably one of the best-unrecognized pianists. Willy had wonderful technique, and he was a great chess player. I guess people in Detroit knew him well, but he was not known well outside Detroit. It is a shame because he was a great player.
I heard the name but I never met him. I think he came later if I'm not mistaken. Some of those names, you know, will not sound familiar to me.
